name: Starter: Marathi
about: Marathi word order, agreement and joined postpositions in real, everyday sentences.

words.असणे: to be; to exist (आहे: is, आहेत: are, आहोत: we are)
words.हवा: wanted, desired (हवा, हवी, हवे agree with the thing wanted)
words.जाणे: to go (जाईन: I will go, जाऊ: we will go)
words.करणे: to do, to make (करू: do; करा: do, politely)
words.तुमचा: your (polite or plural; तुमचा, तुमची, तुमचे)
words.आवडणे: to be liked (मित्राला चहा आवडतो: my friend likes tea)
words.नको: not wanted; don't (नका: don't, politely or to several people)
words.लावणे: to put on; to turn on
words.खाणे: to eat (खातो, खाते: eat; खाल्ला, खाल्ली: ate)
words.माफ: forgiven, excused (माफ करा: excuse me, sorry)
words.येणे: to come (येईल: will come, येऊ: to come)
words.विकत: for a price; by purchase (विकत घेणे: to buy)
words.वाजणे: to strike, of a clock (किती वाजता: at what time)

namaskar.about: The everyday respectful greeting; it works at any time of day.

krupaya.about: The standard polite word before or after a request.

maaf-kara.about: Literally forgive; use it to get attention or apologize politely.

vikat-ghene.about: Literally to take for a price: विकत घेतले means bought.

wrong: एक ग्लास आणि दूध आणि, कृपया.
मी एक ग्लास दूध प्या, कृपया.
नमस्कार, मी एक कॉफी प्या, कृपया.
नमस्कार, मी एक कॉफी पी, कृपया.

items.text: एक चहा आणि एक ग्लास पाणी, कृपया.
items.means: A tea and a glass of water, please.
wrong: मी एक चहा आणि एक ग्लास पाणी प्या, कृपया.
मी एक चहा आणि एक ग्लास पाणी पी, कृपया.
नमस्कार! मी एक चहा प्या, कृपया.
नमस्कार! मी एक चहा पी, कृपया.

No, thank you. See you again!

wrong: नमस्कार! मी भेटून आनंद झाला आहात.

wrong: तुम्ही मला मदत करू शकतो का?

items.means: We'll go to Pune on Saturday.

words.means: प्या = drink, politely; पी = drink, familiarly; पितो = drink

concept.line: A plain Marathi sentence normally puts the object, place and time before the verb: मी चहा पितो (I tea drink).
असणे has मी आहे, तू आहेस, तुम्ही आहात, आम्ही आहोत, and singular तो/ती/ते आहे versus plural ते/त्या/ती आहेत; the common negatives are नाही, नाहीस and नाहीत.

words.means: माझी = my; माझे = my; माझा = my

concept.line: Nouns are masculine, feminine or neuter, and many possessives, adjectives and verbs agree with them: माझा भाऊ, माझी बहीण; a man says मी खातो and a woman मी खाते.

words.means: माझ्याकडे = in my possession; मला = to me

concept.line: माझा, तुझा and तुमचा agree with the thing owned, not its owner: माझा भाऊ, माझी बहीण, माझे नाव.

words.means: हवी = wanted; हवे = wanted; हवा = wanted

concept.line: For habits and general facts, the verb ending follows person, number and often gender: मी खातो (a man), मी खाते (a woman), ते खातात (they eat).

words.means: घरात = in a house; in the house; घर = house
राहता = live; राहतो = live; राहते = lives
जात = going; जातो = go; जाते = goes

concept.line: Marathi puts its short case endings and postpositions after a noun or pronoun and writes them joined: घरात (in the house), टेबलावर (on the table), मला (to me), माझ्याबरोबर (with me).

words.means: जायचे = to go; जाणार = going to go; जाऊ = go
